content.short: Openfort is a gaming-focused smart account infrastructure provider simplifying wallet integration and account abstraction for game developers on Mantle.
content.description: Openfort is an infrastructure platform specifically designed for game developers building Web3-enabled games, providing easy-to-integrate smart account (account abstraction) APIs that handle wallet creation, transaction sponsorship, and session key management. This allows game studios to onboard players without requiring them to manage crypto wallets or understand blockchain concepts. Openfort's gaming-focused SDKs support Mantle Network and multiple other chains for seamless game-to-chain integration.
content.meta: Openfort provides smart account infrastructure for game developers building Web3 games on Mantle. Discover Openfort on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
